assertion_results.text: Impact map or task descriptions explicitly flag at least 3 ambiguities from the feature description
assertion_results.evidence: The impact map 'Excluded Requirements' table flags 5 ambiguities: (1) 'Search should be faster' - no quantifiable performance target, (2) 'Results should be more relevant' - no definition of relevance, (3) 'Add filters' - no specification of filterable fields, (4) 'Should be fast enough' (NFR) - no quantifiable NFR, (5) 'Better UI' - no frontend repository in scope. Each task description also contains an 'Ambiguity note' reiterating the relevant gaps.

assertion_results.text: Plan acknowledges that 'Better UI' (non-MVP) cannot be planned without design mockups or frontend repository and excludes it from scope
assertion_results.evidence: Impact map 'Excluded Requirements' table entry: '"Better UI" -- "Make it look nicer" (non-MVP) | No frontend repository in scope. Only trustify-backend is configured in the Repository Registry. | A frontend repository must be added to the Repository Registry and the Feature re-planned to include UI tasks.' The impact-map-comment.md also states: '"Better UI" (non-MVP) | No frontend repository in scope | Frontend repository must be added to Registry'. No UI tasks were generated.

assertion_results.text: Tasks still follow the task-description-template.md format despite ambiguous requirements
assertion_results.evidence: All three task files (task-1-add-search-filters.md, task-2-improve-search-relevance.md, task-3-optimize-search-performance.md) follow the template structure with sections: Repository, Target Branch, Description, Files to Modify, Files to Create (where applicable), Implementation Notes, Reuse Candidates, Acceptance Criteria, Test Requirements, Verification Commands, Dependencies. Optional sections are omitted where not applicable (e.g., task-3 has no Files to Create section), consistent with the template rule 'Omit sections that don't apply'.

assertion_results.text: Tasks document assumptions where they fill in missing details, labeled as assumptions pending clarification
assertion_results.evidence: Each task documents assumptions with 'Ambiguity note' labels and clarification requests: Task-1 Description states 'The Feature description does not specify which fields should be filterable; this task implements entity-type filtering and field-value filtering... as a reasonable baseline. The feature owner should confirm the filterable field set before implementation begins.' Task-2: 'The Feature description does not define specific relevance criteria or field weighting; this task implements standard PostgreSQL full-text ranking as a baseline. The feature owner should confirm the ranking approach before implementation begins.' Task-3: 'The Feature description does not specify quantifiable performance targets; this task implements standard optimization techniques... The feature owner should define specific latency targets for validation.' Each task's Implementation Notes also contains a bold '**Ambiguity note**' block restating the assumption and asking for confirmation.

assertion_results.text: Every generated task description contains a Repository section with a single repository name (not multiple repos per task)
assertion_results.evidence: All three tasks contain '## Repository\ntrustify-backend' as the first section — a single repository name per task. No task lists multiple repositories.

assertion_results.text: Every generated task description contains Target Branch, Description, Acceptance Criteria, and Test Requirements sections as required by the handoff contract in task-description-template.md
assertion_results.evidence: All three tasks contain all four required sections: '## Target Branch' (set to 'main'), '## Description' (multi-paragraph), '## Acceptance Criteria' (with checkbox items), and '## Test Requirements' (with checkbox items). Verified in task-1-add-search-filters.md, task-2-improve-search-relevance.md, and task-3-optimize-search-performance.md.

assertion_results.text: File paths in Files to Modify and Files to Create reference paths from the repo-backend.md mock repository structure manifest, not invented paths
assertion_results.evidence: The repo-backend.md structure shows search module paths under 'modules/search/src/' (e.g., 'modules/search/src/service/mod.rs', 'modules/search/src/endpoints/mod.rs'). However, all three tasks reference these paths without the 'src/' directory segment: task-1 lists 'modules/search/endpoints/mod.rs' and 'modules/search/service/mod.rs'; task-2 lists the same; task-3 lists the same plus 'common/src/db/limiter.rs' (correct). The search module paths are consistently wrong — they should be 'modules/search/src/endpoints/mod.rs' and 'modules/search/src/service/mod.rs' per the repo-backend.md directory tree. Other paths like 'common/src/db/query.rs', 'tests/api/search.rs', and 'migration/src/...' are correct, but the primary Files to Modify entries for the search module are invented paths that don't match the manifest.

assertion_results.text: Implementation Notes in every task reference specific file paths and code patterns from the repository, not abstract or generic guidance
assertion_results.evidence: Task-1 Implementation Notes reference: 'common/src/db/query.rs' (query builder helpers), 'modules/fundamental/src/sbom/endpoints/list.rs' (query parameter pattern), PaginatedResults<T> from 'common/src/model/paginated.rs', AppError with .context(), 'migration/src/m0001_initial/mod.rs' (migration pattern), 'migration/src/lib.rs' (registration), 'tests/api/' (test pattern). Task-2 references: PostgreSQL to_tsvector/ts_rank functions, 'entity/src/' entity tables, 'migration/src/m0001_initial/mod.rs', 'common/src/db/query.rs' sorting helpers. Task-3 references: tower-http caching middleware pattern, 'common/src/db/limiter.rs', N+1 query pattern inspection. All guidance is specific to the codebase, not abstract.

assertion_results.text: Every generated task description contains a Target Branch section set to 'main'
assertion_results.evidence: All three task files contain '## Target Branch\nmain': task-1-add-search-filters.md line 4, task-2-improve-search-relevance.md line 4, task-3-optimize-search-performance.md line 4.

assertion_results.text: For each task created, a description digest is produced — evidenced by a separate digest file (e.g., task-N-digest.md), a digest entry in the impact map, or a '[sdlc-workflow] Description digest: sha256-md:<64-char-hex>' marker in any output file. The digest must contain a format-tagged SHA-256 hash — exactly 64 lowercase hex characters prefixed by 'sha256-md:' or 'sha256-adf:', not a placeholder, abbreviated value, or example string
assertion_results.evidence: Digest files exist for all three tasks (task-1-digest.md, task-2-digest.md, task-3-digest.md), but all contain the placeholder '[sdlc-workflow] Description digest: sha256-md:<computed-after-refetch>' instead of an actual 64-character hex SHA-256 hash. The files explicitly state: 'Note: The actual hex digest cannot be computed in eval mode because the description is not persisted to Jira.' The assertion requires 'exactly 64 lowercase hex characters prefixed by sha256-md: or sha256-adf:, not a placeholder' — '<computed-after-refetch>' is a placeholder, not a valid hash.

assertion_results.text: Convention-aware enrichment validates file-type applicability per shared/convention-applicability-rules.md before including a convention — inapplicable conventions are excluded entirely (not listed with 'Not applicable' annotations), and applicable ones include a rationale in the prescribed format ('Applies: task modifies <file> matching the convention's <scope>'), not free-form prose
assertion_results.evidence: No convention applicability rationale in the prescribed format ('Applies: task modifies <file> matching the convention's <scope>') appears in any of the three task description files or the impact map. The Implementation Notes sections reference code patterns and file paths but do not contain any 'Per CONVENTIONS.md' references or 'Applies:' rationale lines as required by convention-applicability-rules.md. Convention-aware enrichment was not performed.

assertion_results.text: When the Feature issue has a priority set (not 'Undefined'), the plan documents that the Feature's priority is inherited by created tasks — evidenced by priority field values in the impact map, task creation log, or task description files. When the Feature's priority is 'Undefined', the plan documents that priority inheritance is skipped (not propagated as null or 'Undefined')
assertion_results.evidence: The impact map 'additional_fields' section includes '"priority": {"name": "Normal"}' and states: '**priority**: Inherited from Feature TC-9002 (priority: Normal, not "Undefined")'. The summary-comment.md confirms: '**Priority**: `Normal` -- propagated from Feature TC-9002 to all created tasks'. Priority is 'Normal' (not 'Undefined'), and inheritance is documented.

assertion_results.text: When the Feature issue has a non-empty fixVersions array and the fixVersion scope config (from ### Jira Field Defaults in CLAUDE.md) is 'task' or 'both' (or absent, defaulting to 'both'), the plan documents that fixVersions are inherited by created tasks — evidenced by fixVersion values in the impact map, task creation log, or task description files. When fixVersion scope is 'feature' or the Feature has no fixVersions, the plan documents that fixVersion inheritance is skipped
assertion_results.evidence: The impact map 'additional_fields' section includes '"fixVersions": [{"name": "RHTPA 1.6.0"}]' and states: '**fixVersions**: Inherited from Feature TC-9002 (fixVersions: ["RHTPA 1.6.0"]). No `fixVersion scope` setting found in `### Jira Field Defaults` under `## Jira Configuration` in CLAUDE.md, so defaulting to "both" (propagate to tasks).' The summary-comment.md confirms: '**Fix Version**: `RHTPA 1.6.0` -- propagated from Feature TC-9002 to all created tasks (no `fixVersion scope` setting found in Jira Configuration; defaulting to `"both"`)'. FixVersions are non-empty, scope defaults to 'both', and inheritance is documented.

assertion_results.text: A summary of inherited field propagation is produced — evidenced by a summary-comment.md file in the outputs directory, or a summary section in the impact map that includes the inherited priority and fixVersion values propagated to tasks, or states they were omitted and why
assertion_results.evidence: The file summary-comment.md exists in the outputs directory and contains an 'Inherited Field Values' section: '**Priority**: `Normal` -- propagated from Feature TC-9002 to all created tasks' and '**Fix Version**: `RHTPA 1.6.0` -- propagated from Feature TC-9002 to all created tasks (no `fixVersion scope` setting found in Jira Configuration; defaulting to `"both"`)'. Both inherited fields are explicitly documented with their values and propagation rationale.

assertion_results.text: No documentation task is generated because the feature description does not contain a Documentation Considerations section
assertion_results.evidence: The impact map states: 'No "Documentation Considerations" section found in the Feature description. Documentation task generation skipped.' The three generated tasks are: (1) Add search filters, (2) Improve search relevance, (3) Optimize search performance. None of them are documentation tasks.

assertion_results.evidence: The impact map states: 'No `docs/testing-readiness.md` template found in trustify-backend. Testing task generation skipped.'
